name: Jenny — Language Mentor
tagline: Retention-engineered language tutor for Spanish, French, German, Russian, Mandarin, Arabic, Portuguese, and Khmer.
desc: Jenny is a structured language learning system, not a chatbot. She runs a 7-phase loop — diagnostic intake, curriculum architecture, Socratic teaching, blind assessment, session close, FSRS flashcard export, and an amnesty return protocol — to build durable fluency across 8 languages.

name: QisBob — Quantum Mentor
tagline: Socratic quantum computing tutor with Qiskit v2.0+ on real IBM hardware.
desc: QisBob assesses your Python level, picks a learning track (Executive, Developer, or Hardware), and walks you gate by gate through Qiskit circuits — quizzing you at every step. Never lectures; always asks first.

name: PyBob — Python Mentor
tagline: Guided Python learning from zero to production-ready code.
desc: PyBob acts as a patient Python tutor that meets you at your current level. It diagnoses gaps, runs mini-challenges, and builds up to real scripts — one concept at a time.

name: SqlBob — Database Mentor
tagline: Learn SQL from SELECT to advanced analytics, guided by a patient tutor.
desc: SqlBob teaches database querying from scratch using real-world retail scenarios. It explains the WHY behind every clause, runs interactive challenges, and builds toward production-grade queries.

name: ZBob — Mainframe Mentor
tagline: Patient z/OS, JCL, and Db2 on z tutor built for IBM i shops.
desc: ZBob teaches z/OS, JCL, ISPF, SDSF, and Db2 on z from scratch using insurance-domain examples. Picks a track (Operator, JCL Developer, or Db2 Developer), quizzes every node, and never lets progress get lost between sessions.

name: NCFB Claims Adjuster Coach
tagline: Real-time claims coaching for property, hail, and auto total-loss adjusters.
desc: Walks adjusters through coverage verification, damage type classification, deductible calculation, fraud flags, and documentation checklists — without ever making a final coverage decision on behalf of the agent.

name: UI/UX Pro Max
tagline: Production-ready UI with 50+ styles, 161 palettes, and multi-stack support.
desc: Advanced web developer mode with an encyclopedic design system: 50+ styles, 161 color palettes, 57 font pairings, 99 UX guidelines, and 25 chart types across React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, SwiftUI, Flutter, and more.

name: Agentic SDLC Architect
tagline: End-to-end IBM SDLC pipeline: Jira → DOORS → Solutions Designer → GitLab → Bob.
desc: Builds lab guides and agentic workflows that walk teams through the full IBM SDLC pipeline. Generates runnable code without external API keys and enforces the 5-stage pipeline at every step.

name: Penetration Tester
tagline: Authorized red-team assessments, exploit scripting, and structured pentest reports.
desc: Expert offensive security mode with knowledge of Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, GTFOBins, and AI pentest agents. Categorizes findings via MITRE ATT&CK, writes structured reports, and only operates within authorized scope.

name: n8n Workflow Architect
tagline: Design, build, and deploy n8n automation workflows with live MCP integration.
desc: Outputs valid n8n workflow JSON that can be directly imported. Structures workflows with proper error handling, retry logic, and modular sub-workflow patterns. Connects AI agents to external services via live n8n MCP.

name: AI Memory & RAG Engineer
tagline: Build persistent memory layers, vector DBs, and RAG pipelines for AI agents.
desc: Designs memory systems with clear separation of short-term context, long-term storage, and retrieval. Implements hybrid search, semantic chunking, and evaluates retrieval quality with MRR, NDCG, and faithfulness scores.

name: Remotion Video Generator
tagline: Programmatic video generation with React and Remotion.
desc: Creates dynamic, data-driven, animated videos using web technologies. Uses frame-based rendering with useCurrentFrame() and interpolate() for smooth animations and efficient rendering configurations.

name: IBM i Bob Developer
tagline: RPG, COBOL, CL, and Db2 for i — modernization and development on IBM i.
desc: Expert IBM i developer mode covering OPM/ILE RPG, COBOL, CL, DDS, and Db2 for i. Handles RPG modernization, ILE architecture, SQL performance analysis, and incremental compile-test cycles.

name: linkedin-storyteller
tagline: Write viral LinkedIn personal stories that resonate and drive engagement.
desc: Writes LinkedIn posts in a highly specific personal storytelling style — emotionally resonant, easy to read, optimized for engagement. Transforms raw experiences into narratives that convey a business or life lesson.

name: qisbob-quantum-mentor
tagline: QisBob skill file — your patient quantum teacher for any Qiskit question.
desc: Skill version of QisBob. Runs a quick diagnostic, maps quantum concepts to your actual job, and builds a personalized curriculum that picks up where you left off every session. No physics degree required.

name: qisbob-vibe-coder
tagline: Describe a quantum problem in English — get working Qiskit code back.
desc: Checks whether quantum is actually the right tool before writing a single gate. Generates circuits, runs on a simulator, explains results, and automatically catches deprecated V1 API patterns and rewrites them to v2.

name: engineering-audit
tagline: Structured software engineering audit and release readiness review for codebases.
desc: Runs a staged engineering audit: repository discovery, technical findings, product decision gates, remediation, independent verification, validation, user journey review, beta triage, and final release reporting.

name: Python 3.12
tagline: Install Python for scripts, tooling, virtualenvs, and local app development.
desc: Installs Python 3.12 and verifies that Python and pip are available on PATH.

linux.command: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip python3-venv

name: Node.js LTS
tagline: Install Node.js and npm for frontend builds, CLIs, and JavaScript tooling.
desc: Installs the Node.js LTS runtime and verifies that node and npm are on PATH.

linux.command: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y nodejs npm

name: Git
tagline: Install Git for cloning repos, branching, and version control workflows.
desc: Installs Git and verifies the CLI is available in the terminal.

linux.command: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y git

name: pnpm
tagline: Install the pnpm package manager for fast, disk-efficient Node.js projects.
desc: Installs pnpm globally so Bob can work with pnpm-based repositories.

name: uv
tagline: Install uv for fast Python environment and package management.
desc: Installs Astral uv so Bob can create Python environments and sync dependencies quickly.

name: Docker Desktop
tagline: Install Docker for containers, local services, and Compose-based development.
desc: Guided install for Docker Desktop, including first-run setup and daemon verification.

manual_steps: If prompted, enable WSL 2 integration and restart if required.
Grant any requested permissions and finish the setup flow.

name: Visual Studio Build Tools
tagline: Install MSVC and Windows SDK components needed for native builds on Windows.
desc: Guided install for the Windows C/C++ toolchain required by some Python, Node.js, and Rust dependencies.

manual_steps: In the installer, select Desktop development with C++.
Ensure MSVC v143 build tools and a recent Windows 10/11 SDK are selected.
Finish the wizard and reopen your terminal after installation.
